scripts.start: if [ "$CI" != "true" ]; then export GITHUB_TOKEN=${GITHUB_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token)}; fi && node src/index.js
scripts.bundle: npm run check && npm run build:docs
scripts.fix:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Formatting and linting...' && concurrently -n fix: -g npm:fix:*
scripts.clean-cache:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning npm cache...' && npm cache clean --force
scripts.clean-all: npm run clean && npm run clean-cache
scripts.docs:local:
npm run predocs && printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Generating local documentation...' && jsdoc -c jsdoc.local.json
scripts.package-lock:fix: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const f = 'package-lock.json'; const c = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8').trimEnd(); fs.writeFileSync(f, c + '\n');"
scripts.prettierrc:generate: if [ ! -f .prettierrc ]; then node -e "import('@github/prettier-config').then(m => console.log(JSON.stringify(m.default || m, null, 2)))" | tee .prettierrc; fi
scripts.install:clean: npm run clean && rm -f package-lock.json && npm run package-lock:install && npm install
scripts.postinstall:
npm run package-lock:fix && npm run prettierrc:generate && printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Installation complete.'
scripts.prep: npm run prettierrc:generate && npm run fix && npm test
scripts.all: npm run install:clean && npm run prep && npm run bundle
